_doc: Quarry Bowl: two rubble walls split the floor into three lanes, open at the top and bottom. Rock outcrops for cover: one halfway down each side lane, one above and one below the raised middle (mirrored, every gap 4 cells or more). Tanks smash shortcuts through them (Craglash's Landslide Charge, Cairn's Rockslide Rush); everyone else goes round. Rects are [col, row, width, height] in 8 px cells on the 84x36 grid.
name: Quarry Bowl

tiles._doc: The floor is tiles (assets/arenas/quarry.tscn, built by tools/build_tiles.gd from this block; the recipe tools/tile_recipes/rock.json): Mountains sandstone scree; worn tan-dirt cart lanes along the inside of each rubble wall (Set 1's blob, ragged sides); a raised, rounded middle (Desert v2's packed-earth blob9 with its sandstone ledge along the south side, decor by pos, its rock tops over the patch's bottom row); cobbled loading corners; the walls as raised rock shelves (styles.wall raised:rock: the Mountains plateau's floor as one ridge, rimmed along its sides, its face only on a run's south end, all on the wall's own cells, a long shadow in the low sun) that leave rock heaps where smashed; pebbles, flat stones and dry tufts by the walls (scatter). Rects are [tx, ty, w, h] in 32 px tiles (2 x 2 cells). The hand dressing (`dressing`, assets/README.md "Dressing"): crates, sacks, ore sacks, millstones, tools, log piles, braziers, tripods and lantern posts on the shelves' tops and at their faces' feet, a cold fire pit on the middle's south outcrop; worn ruts down the lanes, packed-earth patches, rubble spills, dropped planks, stone chips, ore bits and dry tufts on the floor.

light._doc: low afternoon sun from the top left: long shadows raking right

grade._doc: dusty low sun, a touch cooler than the warm default so the braziers read warm against it; a view-only tint and vignette (GradeView), eased at night/sunset/rain by weather.json

ambient._doc: dust hanging in the low sun, grit trickling off the rubble walls, a dust devil now and then, thin smoke off the braziers and lanterns (glades: GladeView, smoke only); see AmbientView

lights._doc: the quarry's flames (the dressing's braziers, tripods and lantern posts on the rock shelves; assets/arenas/quarry_dressing.tscn) as lamps that burn by day and more at sunset (`day`, Lighting High only, Light2DView.lamps_by_day): warm pools against the dusty grade; pos is the flame, world px; tests/test_tiles_quarry.gd keeps one on every flame
